games.name: [HIGHLIGHTS] 🌊FE2 2023
games.desc:
Welcome to FE2 2023, this is a recreation of the V57 version of FE2, and maybe even a better alternative to play than FE2.

As we're not money hungry like coolzak35 and Crazyblox, we offer various features and mechanics to make your experience better, whilst keeping the core functionality 1:1 FE2.

These features are what tears us apart from FE2:
Better Physics: We incorporate the prime and best FE2 physics (we don't hate speedrunning/shortcutting, in fact - we endorse it)
Private Server Commands: We have a variety of commands exclusive to the Private Server Owner for FREE, such as setting maps or intensity whenever, type "/cmds" in chat for all commands
Gamemodes: We brought back the Chaos, Pro and Chill Servers 1:1 to how it was in FE2
Optimisation: We tend to be less laggier and generally more optimised than the main FE2 game

Come join our friendly community by joining our Communications Server!
Found any exploiters or bugs? Report them into our Communications Server.
